heads.name: auxiliary_marked_terminal_deletion
heads.head:
theorem auxiliary_marked_terminal_deletion
    {n : ℕ} (w : Shao.Path n) (v x : ℝ) (hx : 1 ≤ x)
    (hFull : 0 < v ^ 2 + Shao.energy w)
    (hCross : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * x * Real.sqrt (v ^ 2 + Shao.energy w) ≤
      |v + Shao.prefixSum w n|) :
    0 < Shao.energy w ∧
      Real.sqrt ((9 / 4) * x ^ 2 - 1) * Real.sqrt (Shao.energy w) ≤
        |Shao.prefixSum w n|

heads.name: prefixSum_cons
heads.head:
theorem prefixSum_cons (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ) (a : Shao.Path n) (k : ℕ) :
    Shao.prefixSum (Fin.cons y a) (k + 1) = y + Shao.prefixSum a k

heads.name: continuous_prefixSum
heads.head:
theorem continuous_prefixSum (k : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun a : Path n => prefixSum a k)

heads.name: continuous_energy
heads.head: theorem continuous_energy : Continuous (energy : Path n → ℝ)

heads.name: Path
heads.head: abbrev Path (n : ℕ) := Fin n → ℝ

heads.name: prefixSum
heads.head:
def prefixSum (a : Path n) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < k), a i

heads.name: energy
heads.head: def energy (a : Path n) : ℝ := ∑ i, (a i) ^ 2

heads.name: energy_nonneg
heads.head: theorem energy_nonneg (a : Path n) : 0 ≤ energy a

heads.name: energy_eq_zero_iff
heads.head: theorem energy_eq_zero_iff (a : Path n) : energy a = 0 ↔ ∀ i, a i = 0
